$comment: Per-suite wall-clock durations (ms) for the general-server Vitest lane, used by scripts/general-server-shard.mjs. Regenerated 2026-11-24 from successful TEA-Core/paperclip actions run 45340330645, head 13fa9e2ca7f8fcc8b056f02fe2ed321b3b03d0cd (https://github.com/TEA-Core/paperclip/actions/runs/45340330645). All five General tests (server (N/5)) jobs completed successfully: 138262964538 / 138262964510 / 138262964600 / 138262964537 / 138262964548, in shard order. Their logs contain 982 suite completions and cover all 980 suites selected at fold head f2ebcb4ef2329afd08e098f39e71d777d39c97a4; two source-only suites are omitted. Each weight is the completion timestamp delta from the preceding suite completion, or from the Vitest RUN line for the first suite. This includes collection, imports, setup and test time with one worker, including skipped-suite overhead. The chat suite now uses its measured cost, not the old artificial single-shard reservation. No older unobserved weights are retained: new or renamed suites use the partitioner's existing median fallback. These weights only change assignment, never suite selection. See the source run job logs to repeat the collection.
